name: specguardian
description: Guardrails that make AI coding agents respect the rules written in your specs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @liangf7943/specguardian-core && npm run build -w @liangf7943/specguardian-guard
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w @liangf7943/specguardian-core && npm test -w @liangf7943/specguardian-guard
scripts.release: npm test && npm publish -w @liangf7943/specguardian-core && npm publish -w @liangf7943/specguardian-guard
